snippet.title: The LEGO® DUPLO® PEPPA PIG app is now available
snippet.description:
Jump into the world of LEGO® DUPLO® PEPPA PIG for happy and playful learning adventures! Available on the App Store, Google Play and Amazon: https://storytoys.com/apps/lego-duplo-peppa-pig/ 

Each activity offers kids fun-filled play experiences with Peppa Pig and her friends and family, all brought to life in LEGO DUPLO form. 

As your little one plays, they will encounter fun and engaging problem-solving challenges that support their learning and development. They will also use virtual LEGO DUPLO bricks to build amazing structures, like their very own treehouse! 

Oinktastic play packs in this app: 
- GARDEN TREEHOUSE 
- BOAT TRIP 
- PEPPA’S BIRTHDAY PARTY 

Packed full of fun, learning, and muddy puddles, LEGO DUPLO PEPPA PIG guarantees giggles and snorts for your little ones! New content will be regularly added to the app for ongoing fun and play.
